{{Youmay|a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based ritual|a [[The Joining|geologic event]] on [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] or the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Joiner]]s}}
A '''joining ritual''' was a term used to delineate any ritual in which a number of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users merged their powers together into a single event. Quite often, the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] employed this practice. Furthermore, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] discovered the effectiveness of joining while fighting the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
